headline: Platform Engineer
subject: A platform engineer who moved 40 services to Kubernetes
paragraphs: I run the deployment platform of the payments team at Example Corp, where I moved 40 services to Kubernetes.
Your posting asks for Kubernetes and Python: I use both every day, with Terraform on AWS and FastAPI.
I have about 3.5 years of professional engineering, about 2 years in a platform title. I would rather say so than round up.
I would be glad to bring this to Lumen Example. I am based in Lyon and my notice period is one month.
